description: Table functions and typing against PostgreSQL through pgx: functions a migration creates read as FROM items, a set of a table's rows, one row of a table's type (a row of NULLs where none matches), several output parameters, one named by its only output parameter, a scalar function under its alias, built-ins and CURRENT_DATE, a LATERAL length and a composite result; CALL of a procedure with an output parameter returns its row and one without runs as exec; jsonb_populate_record and json_populate_recordset give the row type's columns; an unnest of two arrays WITH ORDINALITY reads typed columns; a nested array literal, ARRAY(SELECT id) and ARRAY(SELECT jsonb_build_object(...)) read as arrays; composite fields read the composite type's fields; named placeholders around $1 bind apart; a tsvector column reads as text; and a column override whose type marshals itself to bytes stores those bytes in a bytea column.
